name: bluebird-forecast-eslint
description: Lints frontend/src. A package of its own for the reason tools/api-types is one: typescript-eslint reads the TypeScript compiler API at run time and refuses TS >= 7 outright, the app runs TypeScript 7, and the TS 7 npm package no longer ships that JS API at all. A nested install is the side-by-side arrangement TypeScript documents for exactly this. It also gives Dependabot four packages to bump.
